rubric.notes: Two spec-vs-implementation divergences are documented rather than resolved: (1) ED text rounds the final chunk up after choosing the remaining length, while Chromium + WPT trim it; (2) ED text places the 'fire complete' step beside the 'rendered >= length' check, while Chromium fires complete once at the end. Both read from the fetched ED HTML; an independent reviewer should re-check against the current ED.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation tables without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table headers; wrap tables in an overflow:auto wrapper with tabindex=0, role=region and an accessible name (aria-labelledby a caption); keep cell text legible rather than letting columns shrink below legibility.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: every table is in .table-wrap with tabindex=0 role=region + aria-labelledby/aria-label, has a caption or label, uses thead/th; cells get a 5.5rem min-inline-size and 3+-column tables a 36rem min so they scroll inside the wrapper at 360px instead of breaking words. Exception: no sticky headers / container-query stacking — these are short reference tables.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: 360px captures before/after the fix (crushed 'Con/tex/t' headers before; legible scrolling tables after).

guidanceConsulted.query: lazy loaded cross-origin iframe embed sandbox performance
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Control whether third-party requests send referrer URLs.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the showcase iframe carries referrerpolicy='strict-origin-when-cross-origin' and the repo-mandated sandbox pair; loading='lazy' defers the below-the-fold embed.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible code blocks pre code horizontal scroll focusable
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML and ensure scrollable regions are keyboard reachable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: code samples use <pre tabindex=0><code>; pre has overflow-x:auto so long IDL lines scroll inside the block; long member-name headings use <wbr> at word boundaries instead of breaking mid-identifier.

guidanceConsulted.query: long unbreakable inline code token overflows narrow mobile viewport overflow-wrap
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Fix overflow at the source and do not mask it with overflow: hidden; let containers holding long unbreakable tokens shrink or wrap.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied in the shared stylesheet: inline code inside .warn-block and .citation now uses overflow-wrap: anywhere, so a long flag token breaks instead of widening the page at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest retrieve css-layout, 2026-11-26; scrollWidth 360 at 360x740 DPR3 after the change

openQuestions: Does the current Web Audio ED intend the 'fire complete' step to run after every chunk of a finite render (as the text reads) or only at the end (as Chromium does)? A spec issue may be warranted.
Does the ED's round-up-after-remaining step intend to allow a final chunk longer than length? Chromium and WPT trim; the text does not.
Edge's version for chunkSize / nullable length is not separately recorded (BCD only mirrors close()).
Whether Firefox/Safari throw TypeError for a missing length was inferred from the Web Audio 1.0 IDL, not tested.
